user.title: IMS + Weathercloud
user.description: Pick a language, and optionally a Weathercloud station and refresh intervals.

data.wc_device_id: Weathercloud station id (optional) - digits only, without d

city.title: Select locality
city.description: Pick a locality from the IMS list.

reconfigure.title: Weathercloud station
reconfigure.description: Change the Weathercloud station or login. Leave the station empty to use IMS only. Leave the password empty to keep the saved one.

data.wc_device_id: Weathercloud station id - digits only, without d

reauth_confirm.title: Weathercloud login
reauth_confirm.description: Weathercloud rejected the saved login for station {station}. Enter the current username and password, or leave both empty to stop using the login (public station data keeps working).

error.ims_invalid: Could not fetch data from IMS for that locality.
error.weathercloud_invalid: Could not fetch data from that Weathercloud station id.
error.weathercloud_auth: Weathercloud rejected the username or password. Fix them, or leave both empty to use only the public station data.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this locality and station.
error.ims_cities_unavailable: Could not load the locality list from IMS. Check the internet connection and submit again.

data.station_location: Show the Weathercloud station on the map (adds its position to the weather entity)

icons.title: Custom weather icons
icons.description: Choose which theme to add the weather icons to, or create a new one.

themes_not_loaded.title: Custom weather icons theme not active
themes_not_loaded.description:
Your configuration.yaml does not load themes, so the custom weather-icon theme cannot appear. Add this to configuration.yaml and restart:

frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes/
